m4.bar_desktops: O_DIRECT reads of 557,056 B units 1.6-2.2 GB/s at 1 thread, 2.4-2.8 GB/s at 2, no gain past 2-3; burst writes 1.5-3 GB/s; sustained past SLC 0.5-1.5 GB/s; buffered reads slower or equal with DONTNEED; measured mixed throughput within 15% of the modelled shared lane; per-segment checkpoint iovecs (48 segments) within 10% of the unit rate; engine-loop slowdown beside 2 I/O threads < 3% (preadv releases the GIL)

decision_rules.read_2t: STOP if the 2-thread O_DIRECT read rate of 557,056 B units is < 1.75 GB/s (bar desktops)
decision_rules.mixed: STOP if the measured mixed rate is off the modelled shared-lane rate by > 15% (bar desktops)
decision_rules.copy: STOP if neither cudaMemcpyBatchAsync nor the SM gather reaches 0.8x of the blob rate on fragmented 34,816 B chunks (bar desktops)
decision_rules.stores: STOP if 154 MB stores cost > 2% of decode at the answer rate (bar desktops)
